overview_description.description:
Massdriver is a visual development environment that allows engineers to quickly draw and connect production-ready cloud architectures. Massdriver provides the power of the cloud with the simplicity of a diagram, including integrated security and observability in every infrastructure component.

The company's infrastructures are connected with observability and security, customers can join bundles to build complete systems across geographies or cloud providers without needing to be DevOps experts.

Massdriver was established on June 23, 2021 by Cory O'Daniel in Pasadena, California.

product.name: Diagrammable Infrastructure-as-Code
product.description: A platform that packages infrastructure-as-code, compliance rules, and operational workflows into reusable visual components for provisioning cloud infrastructure.

product.name: Massdriver Service Catalog
product.description: A centralized repository where operations teams publish validated infrastructure modules for developers to discover and provision cloud resources with compliance and cost controls.

product.name: Massdriver Bundle Spec
product.description: A specification that wraps infrastructure-as-code modules to create rich user interfaces enabling developer self-service and interoperability between IaC tools.

product.name: Massdriver Infrastructure-as-Code Template Library
product.description: A collection of pre-built infrastructure-as-code templates for cloud resources across AWS, Azure, and GCP, designed to accelerate deployment and standardize environments.

product.name: Contextual Metrics
product.description: A cloud monitoring feature that provides in-context metrics visualization for quick dashboard creation, alarm setting, and troubleshooting.

product.name: Cost Insights
product.description: A tool that provides visibility into cloud costs to help manage and control infrastructure spending.
